disagreements: Decision 1's verbatim API `pub fn check<P, C>(shell: &Shell<P, C>) -> Outcome<()>` does not type-check: `Shell` is declared `pub struct Shell<P, C, S>` (lib.rs:169) with three type parameters and no default, so `&Shell<P, C>` is a hard 'wrong number of type arguments' error. Implemented as `pub fn check<P, C, S>(shell: &Shell<P, C, S>) -> Outcome<()>`; body, doc comment, refusal and certificate are otherwise verbatim.

Decision 1's verbatim import `use crate::shell::Shell;` cannot resolve: `Shell` is defined at the crate root (lib.rs:169) and only privately glob-imported into `shell.rs` (`use crate::*;`, shell.rs:1), so `crate::shell::Shell` is E0603 'private struct import' (the compiler suggests `use crate::Shell;`). Used `use crate::Shell;`.

Decision 4's test-module header `use truck_topology::*;` cannot resolve from inside the truck-topology crate's own `#[cfg(test)]` module (there is no `extern crate self as truck_topology`); the in-crate module uses `use crate::*;` instead. The `check` doctest is an external crate, so the full `truck_topology::...` path works there as written.

Decision 4's instruction to copy the `singular_vertices` doctest witnesses verbatim into in-crate tests is not compilable as-is because in-crate test code is subject to crate lints that doctest code is not: `Vertex::news(&[...])` trips `clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args` (denied by `#![deny(clippy::all)]`, lib.rs:72) so the needless borrows were dropped to `Vertex::news([...])`, and the witnesses' `v[i]`/`edge[i]` indexing trips the `clippy::indexing_slicing` deny inherited from `invariants/mod.rs`, so the test module carries `#[allow(clippy::indexing_slicing)]` with an H-1 justification comment. The constructed shells are identical to the doctest witnesses.
